reason: The clean-room subprocess wrote a complete result bundle but did not exit normally; its only active threads were waiting after the output had been closed.

observations.shutdown_observation: No additional output writes occurred for more than seven minutes. Process inspection showed every thread waiting in UserRequest state.
observations.termination_scope: Only the clean-room child and its waiting parent verifier were terminated after preservation of the completed raw result.

corrective_action: The clean-room child will fsync its completed result and exit explicitly after flushing stdout. A new framework freeze and full reproduction are required.
